issues.desc: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs + index.json description use "B-skip" as a variant label ("Rejected B-skip", "the rejected B-skip variant") without clarifying that it is NOT a story ID. In the Lattice project the B-xxxx format denotes story IDs; a new reader will naturally try to look up story B-skip. Should read e.g. "Rejected skip-variant (B-skip)" or add a parenthetical noting it is a local variant name, not a story reference.

index.json description attributes the invalid.length > 0 gate block exclusively to Round 2+ ("Round 2+ requires ... no current-round INVALID (stale) binding") while omitting it from the Round 1 description. In the real code (machine.ts canPassReviewGuard line 348) the invalid.length > 0 check fires before the round split and blocks ALL rounds equally. The omission is not materially harmful because Round 1 requires all opt-in reviewers to have valid verdicts (a stricter condition), but the asymmetric framing implies Round 1 does not have the invalid-binding block, which is technically incorrect.

riskSignal matched on keyword TEST gate but the story is about the REVIEW->TEST gate leniency (reads gate, does not modify it). The auto-elevation to high is conservative and acceptable; operator may dismiss via story_review_dismiss after PLAN if desired. No action needed.
